title: Bluesky Introduces Beta Moderation Inbox Feature
excerpt: Bluesky has rolled out a new beta feature that provides a dedicated moderation inbox to help users manage account strikes and reports more easily.
body_html:
Social media platform Bluesky has introduced a new beta feature designed to streamline user safety management. The addition brings a dedicated moderation inbox to the platform, aimed at helping users keep track of account strikes and user reports.

With this new tool, managing safety-related notifications and staying updated on reports is intended to be more straightforward for participants in the beta test. The feature centralizes moderation communications in one designated space within the application.
